mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Add the top-order parity character multiplied by the full Bernoulli variance product to the product law.
mechanism_families.representation: A polynomial map from (0,1)^6 into the 64-outcome simplex interior.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Summing any omitted bit annihilates parity, so every proper marginal forgets kappa.
obligations: Factor every atom for strict positivity.
Derive rank from the extraction right inverse.
mechanism_families.bridge: Singleton extraction composed with the lift is the identity on the open parameter cube.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Any nonpositive atom, nonunit mass, surviving proper-marginal parity term, or rank loss rejects the family.

mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: top parity character + Bernoulli variance product + proper-marginal annihilation + right-inverse rank

mechanism_families.representation: Eight paired complements, type-compatible agent-pair permutations, and accidental toy-coordinate swaps tracked separately.

obligations: Separate type-compatible pair permutations from accidental within-pair toy symmetries.
Give the scalar odd-flip negative control and pseudoscalar repair.

open_gaps: No larger continuum or GL(K) gauge action is supplied.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: finite parity representation + paired even complements + declared relabelings + pseudoscalar obstruction

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Decompose the joint score into marginal Bernoulli scores plus a residual and retain every signed cross term before specializing.
mechanism_families.representation: Six joint score functions in finite L2(Q_kappa).
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Pairwise independence and the score projection identity kill the signed cross terms only in the six-bit parity family.
obligations: Prove residual linear independence for kappa nonzero.
mechanism_families.bridge: The residual Gram matrix is the exact lift-dependent Fisher contribution after the parity-family orthogonality proof.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A nonzero residual null vector or a mismatch at the center rejects the theorem.
verified_results: Positive-definite six-bit residual for nonzero kappa.
open_gaps: The positive residual is not universal across other lift families.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: joint-score residual + signed cross terms + pairwise projection orthogonality + residual Gram PD

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Disintegrate recognition and target over a fixed outside block and cancel their common outside marginal term.
mechanism_families.representation: Strictly positive finite laws on a two-bit agent block times a four-bit outside configuration.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: The global difference equals the outside-weighted conditional local difference only while the outside marginal is fixed.
obligations: State coherent target pushforward for covariance.

mechanism_families.failure_test: A fixed-outside finite counterexample to either equality rejects the family.
verified_results: Exact local/global difference and differential under fixed outside marginal.
open_gaps: Changing the outside marginal adds its own KL and differential terms.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: agent-block disintegration + common outside marginal + conditional KL difference + tangent identity
